identity: Glassroot Wilds is the last elven forest before the front: the gate wardens tend the old roots while wolves run the fringe, apes and panthers hold the tangle, and the canopy has a king who answers to nobody.

quests.title: Room for the Living
quests.text: Rootrunner Wolves hunt the {name:fringe}, which lies {zone_area:fringe}, and after dark their howls press closer to our wardens. Kill five of them to ease the pressure on the paths. I have guarded these woods too long to mistake loving a creature for letting it eat my people.
quests.lesson: Pack hunters: pull from the edge.

quests.title: A Warning Without Words
quests.text: Bring me three Warpack Fangs from the Rootrunner Wolves of the {name:fringe} for our wardens' sleeves. The pack has learned what those trophies mean, and sometimes that is enough to keep a wolf among the trees. A warning understood saves us both a hunt.
quests.lesson: Family drop request; the first hunt's kills count toward it.

quests.title: Regards, and a Leaking Barrel
quests.text: Speak with Toren Waterbarrel at Cinderline Watch in Ashenward March; his water carts keep much of the front alive. Carry our thanks, ask how you can help, and let him direct you onward to Stormvault Heights. Mention that his last barrel watered more roots than soldiers; I suspect the trees are his greatest admirers.
quests.lesson: Contested circuit: the three zones carry the band together.

quests.title: An Unwelcome Rain of Branches
quests.text: By day, the Canopy Apes in the {name:tangle}, which lies {zone_area:tangle}, greet our wardens with whatever comes loose overhead. Kill five of them so we can pass beneath the boughs again. I have tried patience; it did very little for the warden carrying our medicine.
quests.lesson: Territorial brawlers by day in the middle belt.

quests.title: When the Branches Fall Silent
quests.text: The {name:tangle} grows quiet when the apes sleep, which is precisely when our least experienced wardens relax. Kill five Shade Panthers there at night before another patrol mistakes silence for safety. Watch the gaps between the roots; the forest has more than one way of keeping a secret.
quests.lesson: Night stalkers in the same wood.

quests.title: Centuries Felled for Arrows
quests.text: I remember planting the glassroots that the Bandit Fletchers at {name:rootsnare} {dir_from_giver:rootsnare} now fell for arrow shafts. Defeat five of those archers before they cut deeper into the grove. Three centuries of tending, undone in an afternoon with an axe; my patience has grown shorter than the stumps.
quests.lesson: Ranged camp at the top of the zone.

quests.title: No Picnic for {name:basket_biter}
quests.text: We have lost enough provisions near the {name:serpent_pools} to feed a patrol, and the carriers now refuse to go near the water. Kill {name:basket_biter}, the serpent lurking {dir_from_giver:basket_biter} in those pools. I would prefer our supplies to reach the front without first passing through a snake.
quests.lesson: Normal named leader at the top of the zone.

quests.title: Party: No More Broken Bows
quests.text: {name:canopy_knuckle} holds the {name:canopy} {dir_from_giver:canopy_knuckle}; three wardens have returned with their bows snapped across its knee. Gather a party and kill the ape before someone fails to return at all. Bows can be grown and bent anew, but I will not spend my wardens so carelessly.
quests.lesson: Elite climax for a group; the route reaches 40 without it.

quests.title: What We Keep Behind Us
quests.text: You have made room for life here, and that is worth remembering when the front seems to hold nothing else. Speak with Nella Hedgeward at Last Hedge Redoubt in Ashenward March when you are ready to serve beyond these woods. She sends our wardens and soldiers onward; I will keep a place for you beneath the boughs.
quests.lesson: Band end: handoff to a front host.

quests.title: Bounty: Leave a Path Unspun
quests.text: Each night the Canopy Weavers stitch the {name:canopy}, which lies {zone_area:canopy}, shut like a sack someone means to carry off. Kill eight after dark so the wardens can make their rounds. You may repeat this bounty twenty-five minutes after turning it in; weavers this diligent never run short of thread.
